caption: The drawing consists of three sheets of paper laid out side by side. Each sheet has handwritten text in pencil or light grey ink, with a uniform neatness and spacing. The text is written in all-capital letters, forming lists or instructions, with each line beginning with a letter or number followed by a period. The first sheet has a slight brownish discoloration at the top edge, possibly due to age, and contains a list that starts near the top margin with a narrow left margin and generous spacing between lines. The second and third sheets are clean, off-white, and have similar neat columns of handwritten text, each containing several distinct paragraphs or instruction blocks. There are no illustrations, images, or decorative elements, only text. The overall composition is simple and methodical, with each page containing similarly styled writing spaced evenly from the left margin and generally aligned toward the top of each sheet, leaving blank space beneath the last lines of text on each page.
title: Sugar Merchant's Suit (Written Description)
